units.source_text: 她们各自抒情，随意吟咏。

en.t: Each of them gave voice to her own feelings, chanting verses as the mood took her.

units.source_text: 仿佛身在梦中，不问此去何方，亦忘记了家归何处。

en.t: It was as though they were in a dream, neither wondering where they were going nor remembering where home lay.

units.source_text: 只因水面风光异常美丽，足以牵惹青春少女之心情也。

en.t: For the scenery on the water was extraordinarily beautiful, enough to stir the hearts of young maidens.
